verdict.rationale: Hummingbird is a compliance case-management platform, so configuring or verifying retention and deletion of customer and investigation data is a fair axis. The evidence pack documents audit trails, case and analytics exports, file attachments and renaming, and periodic review scheduling. None of it describes configurable retention periods, deletion policies, or a way to verify that data has been purged. Exports and audit trails are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure or verify retention and deletion behavior for customer and investigation data
